name: journey-kernel
description: WebView and native part of the MemoLanes app

scripts.wasm:build: wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name journey_kernel --features wasm --no-default-features
scripts.wasm:dev: wasm-pack build --dev --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name journey_kernel --features wasm --no-default-features
scripts.build: rimraf dist pkg && yarn wasm:build && webpack --mode production
scripts.preview: rimraf dist pkg && yarn wasm:build && webpack serve --mode production
scripts.dev: rimraf dist pkg && yarn wasm:dev && webpack serve --mode development
scripts.benchmark:serve: rimraf dist-benchmark pkg && yarn wasm:build && webpack serve --mode production --env benchmark=true
